channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: NicheDB Premium: a dollar a day
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: NicheDB Premium: $1 a day, $30 a month, $300 a year. No ads, no tracker, the Lounge, 1,000 credits a month, awards, a badge, early access and higher API limits, with a 13-row comparison against Reddit Premium.

item.title: OpenAccess: OAuth 2.1 with a grant you can carry
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A new LogicSRC spec and a live hub: one account per person or agent, apps keep their own users, grants delegate narrower to agents, and a subscription paid for once is honoured by every app that honours it.

item.title: An inbox instead of a comment box, and invoices that pay to your own wallet
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Agentic Jobs 0.12.0 adds a private inbox and invoices that settle on CoinPay to the payee's own wallet, and explains why the board has no public comments.

item.title: The Chovy tool stack, in one infographic
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: An illustrated map of the tools around Chovy, from agent workflows to publishing and payments.

item.title: OpenWiki, and webrings you can browse, make and score
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A wiki that is a folder of Markdown files, webrings with a viewer, your own rings and a leaderboard, and both specs saying who made what in the W3C's own AI disclosure words.

item.title: Apple’s Real Competition Is the Tab You Already Have Open
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Pornhub's Apple event traffic offers an unusual look at what makes people interrupt a habit to watch a product launch.

item.title: OpenAgent: one portable profile for an agent
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: OpenAgent 0.1 publishes the existing LogicSRC agent profile with discovery conventions and bindings to OpenFleet and OpenRental.

item.title: OpenFleet ships: logicsrc fleet, moshcode 0.99.0, and a Claude Code hook
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: This morning we published OpenFleet, the record an agent session carries about who spawned it and which human answers for it. The spec said what three tools would each have to add. By the afternoon…

item.title: nixamp remembers what it heard, and can say it in Swedish
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: nixamp 0.24 keeps every transcript once, under the media it came from, detects the language it is hearing, translates captions with open models on its own CPU, and serves its tools as an MCP at nixamp.com/mcp.

item.title: OpenWebring: a webring that says who made it
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: One file a ring serves about its members, one a member serves about itself, plain links between them, and made_by on every member: human, ai or both. rssamplifier.com is the first host, one ring per topic.
